name: [ 🎃 ] Create a Brainrot
desc:
🧠 Welcome to Create a Brainrot! 💸

🕒 Your Brainrots generate cash even when you're offline!
👍 Like the game & join the group for updates and rewards!

How to Play:
👽 Buy Brainrot Parts
🧠 Build your own custom Brainrots
💸 Generate tons of cash
🏠 Build and upgrade your base to protect them
🔥 Rebirth to unlock even more powerful upgrades!

💻 Play on PC, Mobile, or Tablet – everyone can join the fun!
